ns2:section.sectionText: DOCUMENTARY PRODUCTION AND NON-FICTION FILMAKING - Explore the craft of video storytelling and find your voice as a documentary filmmaker. Students will research, write, film, direct, produce and edit their own short documentary. Prerequisites: JOUR 199 Intro to Documentary Production OR JOUR 215 OR JOUR 340 OR instructor permission. This section will have distributed attendance. You will receive an email from your instructor with specific attendance directives.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
